hook_script: One paragraph, 53-63 words, comma-joined so he does not pause at sentence turns, one question mark at most, Thaqalayn named once near the end. No double quotes inside.
vo_script: One sentence per screen, in the order the screens are recorded.
Each sentence is placed over its own screen, so keep them short and concrete.
Name what is on screen, not what the viewer should feel.
The last sentence should land on the quiz screen.
Thirty to forty-five words in total.

shots.screen: passage list, then the passage title
the narration under the verse, held still
tap the source, source sheet with book and page

_shots_note: One entry per vo_script sentence. Either one screen recording per shot (file only), or one continuous recording with start and end seconds per shot ({"file": "shots/all.mov", "start": 8.0, "end": 14.0}). hold_s is the minimum on-screen time; the assembler holds the last frame longer if the sentence needs it.
header_hook: two short lines|split on the bar 😬📖
header_demo: same as header_hook unless the user asks otherwise|second line 📖
caption: lowercase, one line, in his voice, app named once, link in comments
phrases_hook: covering the whole hook script in order
phrases_vo: covering every vo sentence in order

pronunciation.Sunni: SOON-nee, two syllables, rhyming with moony, never sunnah

_pronunciation_note: Only the words that actually appear in a script are added to its prompt. Add any new surah name, imam name or Arabic term before approval; a mispronounced word costs a $0.47 rerun.
